hints.title: Subsequence and Capital Letter Constraint
hints.text: The pattern must be a subsequence of the query string, and any characters present in query that are not in pattern can only be lowercase letters.

hints.title: Pointer Progression
hints.text: Advance a pointer through pattern while traversing query. If the current characters match, increment the pattern pointer. If they differ, check if the query character is uppercase.

hints.title: Uppercase Rejection Rule
hints.text: Encountering an uppercase character in query that does not match the active pattern position immediately invalidates the query. At string end, return whether all pattern characters were matched.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: L: maximum length of query string
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Regular expressions with complex lookaheads run slower and consume additional regex compilation overhead.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Two-pointer sequential scanning inspects each character once with zero heap allocations.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle the rule that only lowercase letters may be inserted into pattern.
complexity.notes: Time complexity is strictly linear in the total characters across all queries.
